newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land buys stake in Cebu Property.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land buys stake in Cebu Property.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc bought 76 million shares of Cebu Property Ventures and Development Corp from the Cebu provincial government for a total of 144 million pesos, Cebu Property said on Tuesday.
Cebu Property, which is developing a 24-hectare business district in the central Cebu province, is 76 percent owned by Cebu Holdings Inc which in turn is an affiliate of Ayala Land.
Ayala Land would have a direct stake of eight percent in Cebu Property, while the Cebu goverment would reduce its share to 6.9 percent from 14.9 percent.
Cebu Property said Ayala Land bought the shares at 1.90 pesos per share, which is above the trading price of 1.70 pesos posted in early Tuesday session.
